highlights: Reported revenue was $1.13 billion for Q3 2026, up 4.2% from Q3 2025.
Revenue excluding tariff refunds was $1.17 billion, up 4.7% after also excluding the impacts of currency, acquisitions, and the Greater China region (“ROW 1 organic revenue growth”).
GAAP diluted EPS was $1.43 and non ‑ GAAP diluted EPS, excluding tariff refunds, was $1.44.
GAAP operating margin was 27.0% and non ‑ GAAP operating margin, excluding tariff refunds, was 25.0%.

quotes.text: In the third quarter, healthy clinical demand and robust NovaSeq X placements drove results above our guidance. Based on continued momentum, we are raising our full year revenue and earnings guidance.
quotes.by: Jacob Thaysen, Chief Executive Officer of Illumina

outlook: Total revenue of $4.64-$4.66 billion versus prior guidance of $4.60-$4.64 billion.
Organic revenue growth greater than 4% and ROW organic revenue growth greater than 5%, both unchanged versus prior guidance.
Non-GAAP operating margin of 23.6% versus prior guidance of 23.4%-23.6%.
Non-GAAP diluted EPS of $5.40-$5.45 versus prior guidance of $5.30-$5.40.
